name: 23464 · Virginia Bch, VA
findings: ZIP 23464 (Virginia Bch) has 223 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23464 (Virginia Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23464 (Virginia Bch) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
